name: Takashimaya Company, Limited
summary: Takashimaya Company, Limited engages in the department store, commercial development, financial, construction, and other businesses in Japan. The company is involved in the operation of department stores; commercial development and asset management and operation; mixed-use development projects for residential, office, and commercial properties, as well as school property leasing and other related services; and credit card, financial counter, insurance businesses, as well as provides financial product brokerage services.
